title: Push constant padding behavior change in 4.7
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.beta5.official [bbd3f43b5]
- Not reproducible in 4.5 or 4.6

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta5 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.63 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I'm not entirely sure whether this is a bug or a documentation issue. Historically, Godot requires a 16 byte alignment for push constant buffers (see: #113583), but in 4.7 it seems to expect a different (8 byte?) alignment instead.

This might be intentional, but if so it would be a good time to update the docs to make this padding requirement explicit.

### Steps to reproduce

I'm seeing this error in my project when using compute shaders after upgrading from 4.6 to 4.7.
```
ERROR: This compute pipeline requires (8) bytes of push constant data, supplied: (16)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm seeing this issue in the demo project for https://github.com/DevPrice/godot-slang

I can provide a simpler repro project if desired.
